login.notYourCompany: Not your company? <link>Sign in to another one</link>
login.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.ssoFailed: We could not sign you in with your identity provider. Please try again, or check your company address.
login.passwordFallback: System owner? Sign in with a password

validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

defaults.headline: Welcome to noddo
defaults.subheadline: Sign in to continue to your workspace.

password.rule: Use at least 8 characters with upper & lower case letters, a number, and a symbol.

validation.weak: Use upper & lower case letters, a number and a symbol.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: You will be signed out everywhere, here included, and sign in again with the new password.

backupUsed.title: Signed in with a backup code
backupUsed.body: {count, plural, one {# backup code is left.} other {# backup codes are left.}} If you have lost your phone, set up a new one in My Preferences → Two-Step Sign-In.

enrol.title: Set up two-step sign-in
enrol.description: Your company asks for a second step when you sign in.

challenge.title: Two-step sign-in
challenge.backupPrompt: Enter one of your backup codes.
challenge.appPrompt: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.

enrolment.scan: Scan this with an authenticator app — Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or any other — then type the six-digit code it shows.
enrolment.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enrolment.keyPrompt: Enter this key in the app instead:
enrolment.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter a key instead

backupCodes.keepSafe: Keep these somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each one signs you in once. They are not shown again.
backupCodes.confirmSaved: Tick this once you have saved the codes.

section.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {# backup code left.} other {# backup codes left.}}
section.requiredHint: Your company requires it: you will set it up at your next sign-in if you do not now.
section.offHint: A code from your phone after your password, so a stolen password alone does not sign anybody in.
section.oldCodesVoid: The old codes no longer work.

setup.addAccount: Add your account to an authenticator app.

disable.title: Switch off two-step sign-in?
disable.description: Your password alone will sign you in again, and remembered devices are forgotten.

security.privilegedHint: Administrators are System Owners and everyone who can manage settings, block people or act as somebody else — {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} today.
security.withoutFactor: {count, plural, other {# of those the current setting requires have not set it up yet.}}
security.raiseHint: Raising the level signs out the people it now covers who have not set it up; they do so at their next sign-in.
security.rememberNever: Never — always ask for the code
security.ownersAlwaysAsked: System Owners are always asked for the code.
security.idleFor: Sign out after being unused for
security.absoluteLimit: However active, a session ends after 30 days.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.needsCode: This needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.needsPassword: This needs your password once more.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter the email address you sign in with, and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, we have sent a link to set a new password. It works for one hour.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.codeHint: Your account is locked after too many failed sign-ins. Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes, to unlock it.
reset.doneBody: Your new password is set. Anywhere you were signed in with the old one has been signed out.
reset.linkIncomplete: This password reset link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

emailChange.title: Confirm your email
emailChange.description: Confirm {email} as your new sign-in email. Until you do, you keep signing in with your current address.
emailChange.doneBody: From now on you sign in with {email}.
emailChange.linkIncomplete: This confirmation link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

invitation.intro: {hasCompany, select, yes {You have been invited to join {company}. } other {You have been invited. }}Set a password to sign in{hasEmail, select, yes { as {email}} other {}}.
invitation.linkIncomplete: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

done.title: You're in
done.body: Your password is set. Sign in with your email address to continue.
done.bodyWithEmail: Your password is set. Sign in with {email} to continue.

start.title: Get started for free
start.description: Try noddo for 14 days for free. No credit card, setup or cancellation required.
start.successBody: We’ve sent a verification link to your email address. Please open the email and confirm your account before continuing.
start.successHint: Didn’t receive it? Be sure to check your spam or promotions folder.
start.consent: By submitting this form I confirm that I have read the privacy policy and agree to the processing of my personal data by noddo for the stated purposes. In case of consent, I can revoke my consent at any time. Furthermore, by sending the form I agree to the general terms and conditions.
start.addressPreview: Your company will sign in at {address}
start.requiredNote: *For the best experience possible, we ask that you provide all of the required contact details above.
start.haveAccount: You already have an account? <link>Login here</link>

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.description: Create a strong password for your noddo account.
setPassword.successBody: Your password has been created. You can now sign in and continue setting up your company.
setPassword.signsInAt: Your company signs in at {address} — keep that address.
setPassword.goToLogin: Head over to your company's <link>login page</link> to get started.

validation.companyInvalid: Use letters, numbers, spaces and hyphens only.
validation.consentRequired: Please accept the privacy terms to continue.

confirmOthers.title: Sign out everywhere else?
confirmOthers.description: {count, plural, one {# other browser is signed in as you.} other {# other browsers are signed in as you.}} They are signed out at once; this one stays.

step.title: Sign in to your company
step.rememberedPrompt: Continue to the company you signed in to last time, or choose another.
step.prompt: Enter your company's address — the one you sign in at.
step.label: Company address

find.title: Find your company
find.description: Enter the email address you sign in with, and we will email you the addresses of your companies.
find.sentBody: If that email can sign in to any company, we have sent it the addresses. Check your inbox.

impersonation.viewingAs: You are viewing the app as {name}.
